findings.title: Load test and CI gate are missing
findings.description: The slice restates a target of under one second of detection overhead on a local disk. Task 3T tests the walk caps, but the breakdown explicitly omits a load test. Add a load test in `tests/load/` covering the target and a CI task that gates on it.

findings.title: Commit markers are checkboxes
findings.description: Task 2C and the other commit markers are checkbox tasks. Convert them to plain `**Commit**:` lines, retaining them at the existing tested checkpoints.

findings.title: Renderer tests omit required outcomes
findings.description: The slice requires `renderAdoptionFacts` tests for every outcome. Task 8T covers brownfield, adoption-in-progress and not-evaluated, but does not specify adoption-closed, already-planned or greenfield. Add cases for those outcomes.

findings.title: State tests depend on the user's configuration
findings.description: Task 2T expects a missing project config to yield an empty state, but `ConfigManager.get` falls back to user configuration. Isolate the user config in these tests and the integration fixtures so a developer’s `adoption.state` cannot change their results.
